name: billion-context-release-notes
description: Tiered, model-written release notes for billion-context. Read-only companion payload consumed by the proxy's #1870 visibility watcher; version number is bumped by CI on every publish (the field itself is meaningless).

releases.summary: dsh: switching a profile's api protocol (openai ↔ anthropic) silently forked the session — ACP compression state was lost, history re-expanded to ~263% of the window, a full re-fold burned minutes, and the provider prefix cache reset (#2791); anonymous-session identity is now wire-neutral. Every fold used to re-pay a double prefix-cache penalty (56% of uncached tokens in one 12-hour codex log) — summaries can no longer precede the pinned first user message (#2733). Storage: the unified SQLite store lands opt-in (shadow/full, corpus-proven parity, #2671) plus an ownership-review fix pass (#2690); identity-orphan takeovers now surface as conflict events with advice (#2795, #2802). Includes everything since v0.1.191. Restart dsh once after upgrading. 丨 dsh:切换 profile 的 api 协议(openai ↔ anthropic)会静默分叉会话——压缩状态丢失、历史重膨胀到窗口约 263%、全量重压耗时数分钟、上游前缀缓存清零(#2791);匿名会话身份已改为协议中立。修复每次折叠后的双倍前缀缓存惩罚(一份 12 小时 codex 日志中占未命中 token 的 56%,#2733)。存储:统一 SQLite 存储以开关方式落地(影子/全量、语料级校验,#2671)+ 所有权审查修复(#2690);身份孤儿接管现作为冲突事件浮出并附建议(#2795、#2802)。包含 v0.1.191 以来的全部内容。升级后重启一次 dsh。

DSH desktop: after a native-compaction checkpoint landed on the anthropic/google lanes the prefix cache never recovered — persistent cache misses and heavy token waste (#2658, #2596); v0.1.189 added the rebase fallback only to the openai/responses lanes, this release extends it to anthropic/google (#2664). Restart dsh once after upgrading. 丨 桌面版:DSH 原生压缩的 checkpoint 一旦落到 anthropic/google 线,前缀缓存从此无法恢复、持续 miss、token 大量浪费(#2658、#2596);v0.1.189 只给 openai/responses 线补了 rebase 回落,本版补齐 anthropic/google(#2664)。升级后重启一次 dsh。

dsh: long sessions could hit a false "native compaction detected" — any history that merely quoted the dsh checkpoint marker (assistant reasoning, tool output) plus ordinary fold drift reset ACP compression state, re-paying the whole prefix (#2621). Detection now only trusts genuine dsh checkpoints. 丨 dsh:超长会话会被误判"发生原生压缩"——历史里仅引用了 dsh 检查点标记(助手推理/工具输出)+正常折叠漂移就会重置压缩状态、重付整个前缀(#2621);现在检测只认真正的 dsh 检查点。
修复codex 启动器模式启动失败问题,修复claude code账号版本无法使用的问题,修复dsh重试不再泄漏挂死的代理子进程（#2187）。

dsh: compression could silently stop — a background helper (e.g. title generation) hijacked the chat's memory anchor, so it never compressed again, eating context and tokens (#2156, #2160). Helpers are now isolated (#2157); Windows self-update no longer kills bili (#2095). 丨 修复 dsh 静默压缩失效:后台小任务(如生成标题)抢走「记忆锚点」,该会话从此无法压缩、上下文和 token 悄悄暴涨(#2156、#2160);现已隔离(#2157);Windows 自更新后不再退出(#2095)。重启一次 dsh。

Desktop (dsh): after 0.1.179, an update could make bili tools vanish until restart (#2082) — now self-healing, broken desktop updates roll back; re-activating the plugin after a healthy boot also re-registers its tools (#2101); also fixes tool-call misrouting (#2072). Restart dsh once. 丨 桌面版修复:0.1.179 后升级会使 bili 工具消失(#2082),现已自愈;损坏的桌面更新自动回滚;健康运行后重激活插件也会重新注册工具(#2101);另修 #2072 调用错路由。升级后重启一次 dsh。

Update visibility is silent by default (#1977): routine/recommended releases no longer nag on the /acp panel or acp_status — only critical-tier entries surface (CRITICAL UPDATE READY/AVAILABLE). Staleness cues for an installed-but-not-restarted release: web UI banner, /acp one-line warning (#1603, OpenCode hosts today — pi/dsh tracked in #2084), GET /__bili/status.

Emergency carve-out: the output-budget clamp now floors to an integer, so max_tokens / max_completion_tokens / max_output_tokens are always whole numbers. Strict OpenAI-compatible upstreams no longer reject requests with 'max_tokens: Input should be a valid integer' (400) or 'Endpoint is unavailable' (422) — which killed whole agent turns (#2011). Only this fix, on top of v0.1.181.

Window & preflight accuracy wave: dsh context windows resolve again after every resolveModelInfo call failed on a detached receiver (#1943); preflight no longer fires at 59–63% real usage — local estimates are now calibrated against provider-reported usage (#1940, #1933); pi virtual-model selections no longer double-compress (#1962); re-signed SDK-HMAC-SHA256 egress on armed tunnels (#1884).
OpenCode WebSocket traffic is intercepted again — compression and usage stats no longer silently no-op on OpenCode ≥ 2.0.20 (#1844).

Compression is now inherited across agent restart / resume / new-branch forks (#1834): folded summaries survive instead of silently re-expanding on the wire (claude-code and openai-chat wires; codex/gemini in #1853 follow-up).
dsh installs self-heal: profile bundles now converge to the global version automatically (#1803/#1804) — fixes the one-time 'invalid plugin' boot crash after a new bili publish.
dsh: stale landing page after restart fixed (#1787); no-op for other hosts.

Stability wave: zero-injection session identity keeps the prefix cache hot across fork/resume (#1692/#1611); launcher port hardening (#1756); ACP tag-echo strip no longer eats prose (#1722); responses degenerate-output guard and transport replay retry.
